auction.label: Auctioneer
auction.unreadable: The auctioneer cannot find the ledger right now. Try again in a moment.
auction.failed: The auction house could not write that down. Nothing changed hands.
auction.lost: The auction house could not write that down, and what you gave could not be handed back. Tell the staff.
auction.busy: The auctioneer is still writing down your last request. Wait a moment.
auction.closed_far: You walked more than {metres} m away from the auctioneer.
auction.closed_not_in_world: You left the world, so the auction house's window closed.
auction.unknown_category: The auction house has no such kind of goods.
auction.no_item: You do not carry that any more, or wear it.
auction.count: Put up from 1 to {count} of them.
auction.price: A price is a whole sum from 1 to {max} gold.
auction.no_price: Ask a starting price, a price to buy it now, or both.
auction.buyout_low: The price to buy it now has to be above the starting price.
auction.fee_poor: Putting it up costs {fee} gold and you carry {gold}.
auction.too_many: You have {max} lots up already. Wait for one to end, or take back one nobody bid on.
auction.posted: {item} is up for {hours} hours. Putting it up cost {fee} gold.
auction.gone: That lot is sold, ended or taken back.
auction.no_bidding: That lot is only sold at its price.
auction.at_buyout: At {price} gold you buy it now instead.
auction.poor: That takes {amount} gold and you carry {gold}.
auction.bid_placed: You bid {amount} gold on {item}. The house keeps the gold until someone outbids you or you win.
auction.no_buyout: That lot has no price to buy it now.
auction.price_changed: The price is not the one you saw. Look again.
auction.bought: You bought {item} for {price} gold. Collect it at any auctioneer.
auction.withdrawn: You took {item} back. Collect it at any auctioneer.
auction.has_bids: Someone bid on it, so it runs to its end.
auction.nothing_waits: Nothing waits for you at the auction house.
auction.not_collected: You cannot take that now. It still waits for you.
auction.notice.outbid: Someone outbid you on {item}. Your {gold} gold waits at any auctioneer.
auction.notice.sold: {item} sold for {price} gold. The gold waits at any auctioneer.
auction.notice.won: You won {item} for {price} gold. Collect it at any auctioneer.
auction.notice.expired: Nobody bought {item}. It waits for you at any auctioneer.
auction.notice.removed: The staff took down your lot, {item}. It waits for you at any auctioneer.
auction.notice.refunded: The staff took down {item}, which you bid on. Your {gold} gold waits at any auctioneer.
auction.cmd.staff: /aauction list [name] | remove <lot> <reason> - list the open lots, or take one down: the item goes back to its seller and the bid to its bidder
auction.removed_by_staff: Lot #{id} is down. Its item and bid wait at the auctioneers.
